title: Brand manifest
description: brand/<name>/brand.json: everything about a brand that is not copy, tokens or artwork. Copy lives in strings.is.json (key set fixed by strings.contract.json), tokens in tokens.json (DTCG). Frozen identifiers never live here; they are in identifiers/ids.json (docs/decisions/0004).

name.description: Equals the directory name. Lowercase; a leading underscore marks a generated brand such as the rename drill's _fixture.

displayName.description: The name as a store or OS shows it. Must equal strings.is.json app_name.

claims.description: Factual claims this brand's copy makes. A claim set to true requires its exact wording in the strings keyed to it (tooling/brand-check.mjs CLAIMS).

icon.description: The launcher and home-screen icon. The foreground is an SVG on a 108x108 canvas (the Android adaptive-icon grid) whose content stays inside the central 66x66 safe zone; Android masks it to the device shape, iOS gets it flattened onto the background at 1024 px. The background is a colour token and must be opaque. tooling/brand-gen.mjs rasterises both.

fonts.description: Font files bundled with both apps, one per family token (tokens.json font.*) and weight. tooling/brand-gen.mjs copies them byte for byte into the Android font resources and ios/Generated/Fonts/, with each file's licence beside them. A family without files falls back to the system font.

license.description: The licence text that has to travel with the file (the SIL OFL requires it).

source.description: Where the file came from and how it was cut, so it can be rebuilt.

aliasHosts.description: Brand hosts that serve assetlinks.json and apple-app-site-association IN ADDITION to the neutral link host in identifiers/ids.json. Additive only: links inside sent messages always use the neutral host, so a rename never breaks them.

externalSurfaces.description: Places outside the repo that show the brand. The rename runbook walks this list; nothing here is generated.

owner.description: Who can change it, when only one person can.

leakTerms.description: How tooling/brand-leak-guard.mjs recognises this brand's name outside brand/<name>/. Matching is per word, case-insensitive, camelCase split: a word that starts with a stem is a leak unless it starts with an allowed prefix.

stems.description: Lowercase word starts covering every inflection of the name, including umlauted stems.

allowPrefixes.description: Lowercase word starts that share a stem but are other words (a person's name, an unrelated noun). Each needs a reason in allowReasons.

allowPaths.description: Globs (node:path matchesGlob) for files that may name the brand: prose about the project, never code or build input.
